say:1:1321797001:0.text: I've taken care to make Princess Yolena look her very best. Look at how calm and peaceful she is.
say:1:1321797001:0.source_cn: 我已经为亚莲娜整理好遗容了……瞧，她的面容多么安宁。

say:2:1321797002:0.text: Is it time to send her to the temple...?
say:2:1321797002:0.source_cn: 你们……要送她去大教堂了吗？

say:4:1321797003:1.text: Yes, it is time to conduct the funeral for the Archduke and Her Highness.
say:4:1321797003:1.source_cn: 嗯，该为大公阁下和公主殿下举办葬礼了。

say:5:1321797004:1.text: All that remains of the Archduke is the sword he wore with him, and I've sent my guards to retrieve it.
say:5:1321797004:1.source_cn: 大公阁下的遗物只有他随身佩戴的宝剑，我已经派侍卫去取了。

say:6:1321797005:1.text: Now... gently place Her Highness into the ice casket. This is the final gift given to her by Cedartown's acolytes and dwarven craftsmen.
say:6:1321797005:1.source_cn: 现在……将公主殿下挪入冰棺中吧。这是修士修女和雪松镇的...

say:7:1321797006:1.text: After three days of mourning and standing vigil, we will hold a water burial for Her Highness according to her wish.
say:7:1321797006:1.source_cn: 等停灵的三天过去后，我们就按照公主殿下的愿望，为她举行...

say:10:1321797008:0.text: Yes... Thank you for everything you have done for Her Highness, Captain Rodrigo, Dame Temesia, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1321797008:0.source_cn: 好……谢谢你们为公主殿下做的一切，罗德里戈，圣骑士大人...
say:10:1321797008:0.male: Yes... Thank you for everything you have done for Her Highness, Captain Rodrigo, Dame Temesia, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1321797008:0.female: Yes... Thank you for everything you have done for Her Highness, Captain Rodrigo, Dame Temesia, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:15:1321797009:1.text: Let's return to Whiteridge Temple. Ludovic and Valka should be there already.
say:15:1321797009:1.source_cn: 我们也跟大家回白山大教堂吧。柳博米尔和瓦丽卡应该也已经...
